|printed_lore=<span lang="ja">オゼル提督のデス・スコードロンに所属。ホス星系から脱出する反乱軍の宇宙船を捕獲しようと試みた。</span>
|translation='''Title''' — Tyrant.

'''Lore''' — Assigned to Admiral Ozzel's Death Squadron. It attempted to capture Rebel starships escaping the Hoth system.

'''Game text''' — May carry 6 pilots, 8 passengers, 2 vehicles, and 4 TIEs. Has docking capability. A permanent pilot of ability 1 is aboard. When using a tractor beam, add 1 to destiny.
|translation_note=Game text uses タイ for TIEs, ドッキング能力 for ship-docking capability, and a permanent pilot of ability 1 rather than a pilot that provides ability 1.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-D-tyrant.gif|Original English face]], [[Tyrant]].</ref>
